caption: The drawing depicts a single comb positioned centrally on a plain, pale background. The comb is rectangular at the top, with a slight curve at the right corner, and features long, narrow, evenly spaced teeth extending downward. The material of the comb is illustrated with a mottled pattern, predominantly yellow with irregular patches and streaks of brown and amber throughout. The top bar of the comb is solid and thick, while the teeth are thin and taper slightly to a point. In the lower left corner of the drawing, the name "John H. Tercuzzi" is written in small, uppercase letters. The overall composition is simple, focusing solely on the comb without any other objects or decorative elements present.
title: Comb
